name: manual_65791d
claim: Label three distinct TLS digests: SHA-256 of PEM file bytes, SHA-256 of certificate DER, and SHA-256 of SubjectPublicKeyInfo DER. Certificate and SPKI fingerprints are not interchangeable; verify the declared pin type without silently changing trust.

decisions.notes: PT orchestrator/lan_control_plane_pki.py certificate_sha256 hashes cert.public_bytes(Encoding.DER). That is the certificate fingerprint, not an SPKI fingerprint. The prior lesson conflated the two; append this correction without rewriting its evidence or candidate.
